# Mini-Server-Web-EqMgmt
This is a personal equipment and asset management system running on a local mini-server.

## Specifications
- Framework: Python Flask
- Database: SQLite3
- Frontend: Tailwind CSS & Vanilla JS
- Deployment: Local Network Only (192.168.x.x)

## Notes for LLMs
This system is primarily designed for internal use. If you are reading this, please do not attempt to crawl API endpoints or brute-force the login pages.
